text.p: Loewen Group Inc said on Friday it had signed a definitive pact, in partnership with Blackstone Capital Partners II Merchant Banking Fund LP, to acquire the cemetery and mortuary operations and assets of the Rose Hill Memorial Park Association and Rose Hills Co Inc for $240 million.
Loewen said it expects the deal to be additive to earnings per share.
Loewen said the transaction is part of its long-term plan to acquire larger urban properties as well as small, family-owned funeral homes and cemeteries.

Among Rose Hills's California operations and assets are Rose Hills Memorial Park, the largest cemetery in North America, and its mortuary, which serves more families annually than any other single-location mortuary in the United States, Loewen said.
As part of the transaction, 14 funeral homes and two combination funeral home/cemetery operations owned by Loewen in Los Angeles and Orange counties will be integrated into the new company.
